name: writing-report-skill-by-sheng
description: Draft, revise, and polish completed Chinese academic research reports from a user-locked research framework.

interface.displayName: 中文学术研究报告写作
interface.shortDescription: 起草或润色出站报告、学位论文等已完成工作的中文研究报告。
interface.longDescription: A portable Agent Skill that drafts, revises, and polishes completed Chinese academic research reports. It requires existing results and a user-locked research framework, then dispatches to abstract, introduction, related work, conclusion, technical chapters, or Chinese academic polishing.
defaultPrompt: Use $writing-report-skill-by-sheng to draft or polish this Chinese research report.
Lock the research framework first; do not invent topics, methods, or numbers.
